description: Reproducible v4 RUNG_TX rejection vectors. Each entry is a malformed createrungtx input plus the JSON-RPC error the node returned. Independent implementations must reject the input and surface a comparable error category. Generated by test/functional/generate_rung_tx_neg_vectors.py — re-run to regenerate.

vectors.actual_error_message: Block SIG field count mismatch: got 2, expected 1 per implicit layout for SIG_CONDITIONS (-8)
